description: Zero-shot classifier/splitter for workers' compensation submission bundles (brief 04; v2 brief 08d: fax and scan renderings named in the LossRun description). No training data: categories are described as mini-prompts. Version the analyzer id (-v3, ...) instead of editing a deployed definition.

LossRun.description: An insurance loss run (loss history / claims history / experience report) issued by a carrier or TPA: a header with carrier, insured, policy numbers and a valuation or 'as of' date, followed by a table of claims (claim number, claimant, date of injury or loss, status, paid / reserve / incurred amounts) and/or policy-period subtotals and totals, or a statement that no losses were reported. It may arrive as a fax or a low-resolution scan: black-and-white or binarized, skewed or rotated, speckled, with OCR misreading letters and digits in headers and amounts (e.g. 'Clalm No', 'Accldent Dt'); a dense grid of dates and currency amounts under claim-number and paid/reserve column headings is still a loss run.

ExperienceModWorksheet.description: A workers' compensation experience rating / experience modification worksheet (WCIRB or NCCI): rating date, experience period, class codes with payroll and expected losses, actual primary and excess losses, ballast, and the resulting modification factor.

Payroll.description: A payroll report or payroll-by-class schedule: class codes or job descriptions with employee counts and annual or period payroll amounts, as used for workers' compensation rating or premium audit.

AcordApplication.description: An ACORD insurance application or form (e.g. ACORD 125, 130 workers compensation application, 131): numbered form fields for applicant, locations, class codes, prior carrier history, and signatures, with the ACORD form layout.

Correspondence.description: A letter, cover note, or email from a broker, agent, insured, or carrier: salutation, narrative paragraphs, and a signature; not a table of claims or payroll.

Other.description: Any other page that is not a loss run, experience modification worksheet, payroll report, ACORD application, or correspondence (e.g. financial statements, safety manuals, blank pages).
